name: dsh-kb-ingest
description: Source-to-knowledge-base ingest desk: kb_ingest_source turns Markdown / plain text / DOCX / EPUB / text-layer PDF into a searchable corpus entry plus a verbatim-fidelity Chinese Word (scanned PDFs are rejected with an OCR-pipeline pointer), kb_verify_word re-runs the character-fidelity gate, kb_ingest_status reports corpus coverage and gate status. · 源文件入库台：kb_ingest_source 把 MD/TXT/DOCX/EPUB/带文字层 PDF 变成可检索书库并产出逐字一致的中文 Word（扫描版拒绝并提示走 OCR 主流水线），kb_verify_word 复核保真门，kb_ingest_status 查语料覆盖与门禁状态。
